app.name: NewBedwars Panel
login.title: Log in to the panel
login.intro: Use the account an admin created for you with /nbwpanel user create.
login.name: Account name
login.locked: Too many wrong tries. Try again in {minutes} min.
password.title: Change your password
password.required: Your password was set by an admin and works only once. Choose your own password to continue.
password.hint: At least 10 characters. Other sessions of this account are logged out.
password.mismatch: The two new passwords are different.
dash.title: Arenas
dash.noArenas: No arenas on this server yet. Create one in game with /bw arena create.
dash.networkNote: Read only: manage these on their own game server.
dash.stale: No answer from the server. Showing the last known state.
dash.importHint: Upload a .zip made with Export (or /bw arena export). The imported arena starts disabled.
arena.notFound: This arena does not exist (any more).
arena.noBackups: No backups yet. Back up now to make the first one.
arena.restoreConfirm: Restore {arena} from backup {id}? The current arena file and map are replaced.
arena.resetConfirm: Reset the map of {arena} to its saved state?
arena.disableConfirm: Disable {arena}? Players waiting in it are sent out.
arena.deleteConfirm: This deletes {arena}: its file, world and saved map. Backups are kept. Type the arena name to confirm.
users.title: Accounts
users.name: Account name
users.oneTimeNote: Give it to them privately. It is shown only now and must be changed at the first login.
users.resetConfirm: Give {name} a new one-time password? They are logged out.
users.deleteConfirm: Delete the account {name}? It is logged out at once.
roles.title: Roles
roles.intro: A role is a set of permissions. admin can do everything and staff can only view the arenas; both are built in and can not be changed.
roles.name: Role name
audit.title: Activity
audit.intro: Who did what in the panel and with /nbwpanel. Also written to plugins/NewBedwars-Panel/audit.log.
error.network: The panel can not be reached. Is the server running?
error.forbidden: Your role does not allow this.
error.csrf: Your session is out of date. Reload the page.
error.login_required: Your session ended. Log in again.
error.password_length: The password must have 10 to 128 characters.
error.password_same: The new password must be different from the current one.
error.password_weak: The password can not be the account name.
error.locked: Too many wrong tries. Wait a few minutes.
error.exists: An account with this name already exists.
error.invalid_role_name: Role names have 2-32 characters: lowercase letters, digits, _ -
error.built_in_role: Built-in roles can not be changed.
error.role_in_use: Some accounts still have this role. Give them another role first.
error.last_admin: The last admin account must stay an admin.
error.too_large: The file is larger than the upload limit (Upload.MaxMegabytes).
error.file_exists: A file with this name is already in the exports folder. Rename the file or import the existing one.
error.bad_file_name: Use a .zip file name with letters, digits, _ . -
error.timeout: The server did not finish in time. Check the console.
error.not_ready: The server is still starting. Try again in a moment.
error.save_failed: The account file could not be saved. Check the console.
stats.title: Player stats
game.title: Game
game.broadcastLabel: Message to everyone in this arena
game.broadcastHint: & colour codes work, up to 256 characters
game.noActions: Nothing to control while the arena is in this state.
game.stopConfirm: End the game in {arena} as a draw? Stats are saved.
game.forcestopConfirm: Stop {arena} now? Everyone is sent out and the map is reset.
log.title: Game log
log.privacy: Includes team chat. Kept until the next game in this arena starts.
perm.game.manage: Start, stop and skip phases of games, broadcast
perm.game.log: Read the game log (includes team chat)
error.stats_unavailable: Stats can not be read right now (database?).
perm.shop.edit: Edit shop items, shop GUIs and the shops of arenas
shop.title: Shop editor
shop.item.notFound: There is no item with this name.
shop.item.name: Name
shop.item.nameHint: Letters, digits and _ only. The name can not be changed later.
shop.item.priceHint: -1 for upgrade icons: the price then comes from config.yml.
shop.item.permissionHint: Needed to buy the item. Leave empty for everyone.
shop.item.saved: Item saved. Players see it the next time they open a shop.
shop.item.deleteConfirm: Delete the item {name}? A copy of items.yml is kept in data/backups/shop/.
shop.item.usedBy: Used by: {list}. Remove it there before deleting it.
shop.texts.title: Texts
shop.texts.hint: Use & colour codes. The texts are stored in the language files (CustomItemsNames).
shop.texts.name: Display name
shop.texts.iconHint: ; starts a new line. /price/, /amount/ and /name/ are replaced. Empty = the default text.
shop.gui.notFound: There is no GUI with this id.
shop.gui.title: Title
shop.gui.layoutHint: Header and footer rows are shown on every page. The rows between them show the home page, or the items of the open category.
shop.gui.zoneContent: Content: shown on the home page.
shop.gui.invalidToken: This slot has a value the editor does not know: {value}
shop.gui.keys: Arrow keys move between slots, Delete empties a slot. Drag slots to swap them.
shop.gui.paletteHint: Drag an entry onto a slot or a category, or select a slot and click an entry.
shop.gui.categoriesHint: A category is a button that opens a page with its items. The category with the id home is the start page.
shop.gui.categoryDescription: Button description (; starts a new line)
shop.gui.categoryItemsHint: In this order. Drop palette entries here.
shop.gui.removeCategoryConfirm: Remove the category {id}? Slots that open it become empty.
shop.gui.problems: Some references could not be resolved:
shop.gui.problemsHint: They stay in the file unchanged, so the GUI works again when the item exists. New references must be valid.
shop.gui.saved: GUI saved. Players see it the next time they open a shop.
shop.gui.deleteConfirm: Delete the GUI {id}? A copy of the file is kept in data/backups/shop/.
shop.gui.usedBy: Used by: {list}. It can not be deleted while it is used.
shop.arenas.hint: Which GUI the item shop and the upgrade shop of each arena open. Only arenas that are waiting can be changed.
shop.arenas.none: There are no arenas on this server.
